brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent where following an instruction ends and interpreting it begins.

actions.title: Continue, Otherwise
actions.statement: Three equal cuts follow a rule through the city. At a thin horizontal threshold, the upward movement continues as a flower and an upturned flamingo: continuity without obedience to the original shape. Interpretation begins where the direction survives but the form is no longer prescribed.

notes.note: Begin with three equally spaced architectural strips: a measured, repeated instruction. A dark circular field interrupts their common top edge and opens a space for a different kind of construction.

The equal columns establish the rule. I will let a red, curved neck rise against the black field, while a botanical stem grows from the last column: the same upward movement changes from measured repetition into a living contour.

The flower currently conceals the bird’s head. I will separate their silhouettes and turn the red neck so its lower end meets the last architectural strip. A fine horizontal rule will mark that junction without enclosing the forms above it.

The red neck now grows directly from the ruled edge. Lowering the flower slightly will give it the same point of departure, while preserving the contrast between straight architectural strips and divergent living forms. The surrounding paper will remain open.

actions.statement: Three equal cuts follow a rule through the city. At a thin horizontal threshold, the upward movement continues as a flower and an upturned flamingo: continuity without obedience to the original shape. Interpretation begins where the direction survives but the form is no longer prescribed.

notes.note: The final canvas holds a clear transition: evenly spaced city strips meet the horizontal rule, while the flower and red neck continue upward in different directions. The black field and open paper give those departures room. The composition is finished.
